start.title: Figli di Adamo
start.text:
Apri gli occhi come il primogenito di Adamo ed Eva.
Un secondo figlio, Abele, nasce dopo di te.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Live as the firstborn son of Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 4:1-2 — Eve gave birth to Cain, and then to his brother Abel.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Be born before Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Adam and Eve came first; Cain was their son.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Grow up as an only child
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Cain had a brother, Abel.

fields.title: Il Tuo Lavoro
fields.text:
Gli anni passano. Ogni fratello trova il suo lavoro.
Qual è il tuo?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Work the ground as a tiller of the soil
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 4:2 — Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Keep flocks of sheep like Abel
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Abel kept flocks; Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Refuse to work at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Cain worked the ground.

abel_pasture.title: Il Lavoro di Tuo Fratello
abel_pasture.text:
Vedi Abele dall'altra parte del campo.
Cosa sta facendo?

choices.text: [TODO:it] See Abel keeping flocks of sheep
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 4:2 — Abel kept flocks.

choices.text: [TODO:it] See Abel tilling the ground beside you
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Abel kept flocks, not that he tilled the ground.

choices.text: [TODO:it] See Abel fishing at the river
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis does not describe Abel fishing.

offerings.title: Davanti all'Altare
offerings.text:
Arriva il momento di portare un'offerta al Signore.
Cosa porterai?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Bring some of the fruits of the soil as an offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 4:3 — Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Bring a firstborn lamb from your flock
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Abel brought a lamb; Cain brought fruits of the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Bring nothing at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Cain did bring an offering, though not the best.

accepted.title: Lo Sguardo del Signore
accepted.text:
Aspetti mentre il Signore guarda le due offerte.
Cosa succede?

choices.text: [TODO:it] The Lord looks with favor on Abel and his offering, but not on yours
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 4:4-5 — The Lord looked with favor on Abel and his offering, but on Cain and his offering He did not look with favor.

choices.text: [TODO:it] The Lord favors both offerings equally
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says the Lord favored Abel's offering, not both.

choices.text: [TODO:it] The Lord accepts your offering and rejects Abel's
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says the opposite — the Lord favored Abel's offering.

anger.title: Il Tuo Volto Cade
anger.text:
L'offerta è finita. Qualcosa sorge in te.
Come reagisci?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Become very angry, your face downcast
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 4:5 — Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Rejoice with Abel over his accepted offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Cain became angry, not that he rejoiced.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Bring a better offering the very next day
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis does not describe Cain bringing a second offering.

warning.title: Il Peccato Accovacciato alla Porta
warning.text:
Il Signore ti parla.
Cosa dice?

choices.text: [TODO:it] 'Sin is crouching at your door — but you must rule over it'
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 4:6-7 — The Lord warned Cain that sin was crouching at his door and he must rule over it.

choices.text: [TODO:it] 'Bring a lamb instead of grain'
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis does not record the Lord telling Cain to bring a lamb.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Nothing — the Lord is silent
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says the Lord did speak to Cain about sin at the door.

invitation.title: Parli a Tuo Fratello
invitation.text:
Abele si avvicina, fiducioso.
Cosa dici?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Say to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field'
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 4:8 — Cain said to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field.'

choices.text: [TODO:it] Invite Abel to worship at the altar together
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Cain led Abel out to the field, not to the altar.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Send Abel away and never speak to him again
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Cain called Abel to the field, not that he sent him away.

field.title: Nel Campo
field.text:
Tu e Abele siete soli nel campo aperto.
Che fai?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Attack Abel your brother and kill him
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 4:8 — Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Argue with Abel and then forgive him
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Cain killed Abel; he did not forgive him.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Walk home without touching him
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Cain killed Abel in the field.

confrontation.title: «Dov'è tuo fratello?»
confrontation.text:
La voce del Signore ti trova.
«Dov'è Abele, tuo fratello?»

choices.text: [TODO:it] Answer: 'I do not know. Am I my brother's keeper?'
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 4:9 — Cain replied, 'I don't know. Am I my brother's keeper?'

choices.text: [TODO:it] Confess plainly: 'I have killed him'
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Cain denied knowing; he did not confess plainly.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Stay silent before the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Cain answered the Lord; he did not stay silent.

wanderer.title: Un Vagabondo Irrequieto
wanderer.text:
Il Signore ti pone un segno per la tua protezione.
Tu vai a vagare a est dell'Eden, nella terra di Nod.
